components.title: AirPlay HP service
components.description: For the app AirPlay HP: the AirPlay receiver "BMW iDrive" (UxPlay's protocol on the head unit). The iPhone's screen mirroring, evened out by a jitter buffer, decoded on the GPU into mgu-render's frame file and its sound into SmartXbar's CarLife input; a video sent with the AirPlay button (YouTube) played by its own player from the internet (mgu-uplink, through a proxy running as uid 13102). Opens the firewall for its ports only while the receiver runs.
components.author: hubertpacholek, aurelmarius

pl.title: Usługa AirPlay HP
pl.description: Odbiornik AirPlay (protokół UxPlay) dla aplikacji AirPlay HP: obraz dekodowany na GPU, dźwięk do głośników auta, bufor wyrównujący dla odbicia lustrzanego ekranu.

components.title: AirPlay HP
components.description: The head unit as an AirPlay receiver for an iPhone: screen mirroring on the centre screen with the sound on the car's speakers (also with wireless CarPlay connected), and videos sent with the AirPlay button (YouTube) played by the head unit itself, with their controls on the iDrive. The picture shows while parked. Needs the AirPlay HP service.
components.author: hubertpacholek, aurelmarius

pl.title: AirPlay HP
pl.description: Odbiornik AirPlay dla iPhone'a: odbicie lustrzane ekranu na środkowym ekranie z dźwiękiem w głośnikach auta, wyrównane buforem, żeby filmy nie przycinały. Obraz tylko na postoju. Wymaga usługi AirPlay HP.
